Round 398 passes: 0 bugs, and every browser row ran, so `browserVerified` is true. I did not re-run A's five unit mutants (A reports 5 of 5 red). The full vitest, typecheck, build, Biome and verify checks are left to the root gate and are not claimed.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| SCALE-SPEC (run alone) | Pass. The run returned rc 0 with no failures, no problems and no page errors in any of the 3 passes. All 23 rows have 3 samples. |
| PERF-RES (run alone) | Pass. The six DOM-count rows match round 396 exactly (page 684/751/769, clip subtree 17, ruler 95/95). |
| COUNT-BROWSER (1440×900 and 1280×720) | Pass. `data-clip-count` equals the mounted clip count on every lane at every step. Duplicate gives 3/0, held 3/0, released 2/1, undo 3/0, and folding Music keeps 3. |
| NO-VISIBLE-CHANGE | Pass. Both greps return 0 hits. I took empty and demo screenshots at both viewports. |
| AUTH (fresh context, no credentials) | Pass. `/studio-lab` opens the demo, `/studio/<handle>` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. |
| SOURCE-SCOPE | Pass. Only the 5 granted files differ, and the `ArrangementLane.tsx` diff is the single added line. The frozen manifest has 0 failures and all 11 protected files match. |
| DOCS | Pass. Doc 254 is in Georgian with the 7 template headings in order and the exact line 4. `In Progress (stage` appears in 4 files. |

The scale spec medians at 1440×900 are close to B's dev probe. Page elements are 4333 and the clip subtree is 3400. The model and mounted clip counts are both 200. The zoom keydown maximum is 40 ms at 1× and 192 ms at 6×.

I'm passing three signals to B, none of them bugs:
- **In-window count:** `scale.clips.in-window*` counts clips under the sticky header column, so min-zoom-mid reads 24 where about 19 are in the lane area. B should define "window" before PERF-14b turns these into asserts.
- **p95 statistic:** with 10 keys, the zoom p95 always equals the maximum, so the "p95 < 50 ms" target needs more keys or a different statistic.
- **Environment:** the first COUNT-BROWSER run at 1440×900 exited with a Node error I couldn't diagnose. The reruns passed. I logged it as a Low environment note.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-398.md`
- `c-round-398.json`
- `c-round-398/`
